items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer asks about 'Duck Ernest' in the context of 'Buddy's gang', but the interviewee only responds to the question about Buddy Manaday, stating 'I played with Buddy Manaday'. There is no statement from the interviewee confirming a relationship with Duck Ernest.

ctx.x: Oh, I don't think so. I don't know. I don't know.
Let's see Duck Ernest play bass. I'm trying to think of who the different guys have played, you know, around with Buddy's gang. Uh, Buddy Manaday. Did you know him?
Buddy Manaday. What do you play, banjo? Buddy Manaday? Yeah, I played with Buddy Manaday. Buddy Manaday. Buddy Manaday. He ain't a slender, slender, slender fella, huh?
